query:
UPDATE systems SET
                    position = COALESCE($2, systems.position),
                    body_count = $3,
                    non_body_count =
                        COALESCE($4, systems.non_body_count),
                    updated_at = GREATEST(systems.updated_at, $5),
                    updated_by = CASE WHEN $5 >= systems.updated_at
                        THEN $6 ELSE systems.updated_by END
                WHERE address = $1
